controls_rule: Freeze validation standalone common prompts to the selected policy version (v2 or v3). The development v2 whole-policy ablation cannot isolate delegation effects against v3 standalone controls.
selection: Maximum development resolution count, minimum total model inference cost, fixed lexical tie; all attempts retained
first_unit: One complete four-arm development block only after independent controls, boundary, token metering, immutable-feedback and fresh-regrade validation
feedback: Same two-stage test-error opportunity in every arm; final executable registration must freeze truncation, test commands, time, turn, context and expert budgets before the first scored invocation
quality_scope: Aider-derived custom conversational test-feedback results, not official Aider scores
stop_rules: Preserve uncertain model attempts; never silently repeat them
No validation tuning or task replacement based on outcomes
Stop on environment or grading ambiguity
Report target failure rather than extending until a desired score appears
